mapper.sql: id, employee_id, version, is_latest, effective_date, expiry_date, audit_status, base_salary, full_attendance_bonus,probation_base_salary, currency, change_reason,tax_scheme, remark, delete_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT sa.id, sa.employee_id, sa.version, sa.is_latest, sa.effective_date, sa.expiry_date, sa.audit_status, sa.base_salary, sa.full_attendance_bonus, sa.probation_base_salary, sa.currency, sa.change_reason, sa.tax_scheme, sa.version, sa.remark, se.employee_name, se.employee_code FROM salary_archive sa INNER JOIN salary_employee se ON sa.employee_id = se.id AND se.delete_flag = 0 WHERE sa.delete_flag = 0
AND sa.is_latest = #{req.isLatest}
AND (se.employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR se.employee_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY sa.update_time DESC

SELECT sa.*, se.employee_name, se.employee_code, sai.type_id, sai.item_type, sai.calc_type, sai.base_amount, sai.amount, sai.ratio, sai.type_name, sai.category_name, sa.tax_scheme FROM salary_archive sa INNER JOIN salary_employee se ON sa.employee_id = se.id AND se.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_archive_item sai ON sa.id = sai.archive_id AND sai.delete_flag = 0 WHERE sa.id = #{archiveId} AND sa.delete_flag = 0

SELECT sa.*, se.employee_name, se.employee_code, sai.type_id, sai.item_type, sai.calc_type, sai.base_amount, sai.amount, sai.ratio, -- 🌟 调整：直接取冗余字段 sai.type_name, sai.category_name, sa.tax_scheme
FROM salary_archive sa INNER JOIN salary_employee se ON sa.employee_id = se.id AND se.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_archive_item sai ON sa.id = sai.archive_id AND sai.delete_flag = 0 WHERE sa.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND sa.is_latest = 1 AND sa.audit_status = 1 AND sa.delete_flag = 0

SELECT sa.*, se.employee_name, se.employee_code, sai.type_id, sai.item_type, sai.calc_type, sai.base_amount, sai.amount, sai.ratio, -- 🌟 调整：核算时直接用快照名，避免核算过程中再去关联字典表，极大提升批处理性能 sai.type_name, sai.category_name, sa.tax_scheme FROM salary_employee se INNER JOIN salary_archive sa ON se.id = sa.employee_id AND sa.is_latest = 1 AND sa.audit_status = 1 AND sa.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN salary_archive_item sai ON sa.id = sai.archive_id AND sai.delete_flag = 0 WHERE se.employment_status = 1 AND se.delete_flag = 0
